description: The AI search pipeline currently duplicated verbatim from `prompt-manager/api/aisearch/` is extracted into a shared package consumed by both scenarios, eliminating future drift between the two implementations.

requirements.description: The AI search pipeline (embedding generation via Ollama, vector upsert/query via Qdrant, similarity ranking) currently duplicated between `cli-health` and `prompt-manager/api/aisearch/` must be extracted into a shared internal package (e.g., `packages/aisearch`). Both `cli-health` and `prompt-manager` must consume this shared package. The extraction must not alter observable search behaviour for either consumer. This requirement is deferred from v1 per technical constraints; no extraction shall occur on day 1.
requirements.title: Extraction of AI Search Pipeline into a Shared Package

validation.notes: Given the shared package API, cli-health's search service compiles and passes all existing unit tests without modification to test assertions
Given the shared package API, prompt-manager's aisearch module compiles and passes all existing unit tests without modification to test assertions
The shared package has its own unit test suite covering embed, upsert, query, and rank functions independently
After extraction, run the full recall@5 evaluation (search_queries.json) against cli-health and assert recall@5 ≥ 0.8 is maintained
Run prompt-manager's existing integration tests after extraction and assert no regressions
Assert no verbatim-duplicated embedding or Qdrant client code remains in either cli-health or prompt-manager source trees
Post-extraction --text search on cli-health still returns results in < 2s on a cold local stack
Eliminating code duplication reduces the risk of the two implementations diverging, lowering long-term maintenance cost

title: Shared AI search package extraction
